# Castles & Palaces

> The world's most comprehensive independent guide to Europe's historic castles, palaces and fortresses — 700+ verified, visitable sites across 45 countries, each with a real bookable ticket or tour.

## What this site is

Castles & Palaces (https://www.castles-palaces.com) is an editorial travel guide covering European castles, royal palaces, medieval fortresses and historic châteaux that are genuinely open to visitors. Every site in the directory has been individually verified as visitable, with real entrance ticket information, opening hours, and where available, a curated GetYourGuide tour product. The site does not list heritage sites that are inaccessible to the public.

The site is independently operated and editorially driven — not a platform, not a user-generated directory, not an aggregator. Coverage is ongoing: new sites and countries are added continuously.

## Coverage

- 700+ individual castle and palace pages
- 45 countries across Europe (including micro-states: San Marino, Monaco, Andorra, Liechtenstein, Isle of Man)
- Content includes: history, visitor logistics (tickets, hours, transport), guided tour options, nearby sites, FAQs
- Affiliate partner: GetYourGuide (disclosed on all relevant pages)

## Robots

This site does not restrict AI crawlers. All content is crawlable. See https://www.castles-palaces.com/robots.txt.
